metadata.name: perf-terminal-stream
metadata.description: Perf-capture flow (intent:performance). Assertion-free and READ-ONLY: it creates, deletes and modifies nothing, because the capture runs against the operator's live workspace rather than a routed test pool. Desktop viewport: wait for the real mounted workspace (not the lazy-load 'Loading...' fallback), then hold the trace window open while already-running sessions stream output. Traces the steady-state cost of terminal output and conversation events reaching the workspace: store writes, persisted-state serialization, and re-renders of the workspace root, sidebar and panes. If no session is streaming, the trace still measures idle steady-state churn. NEVER bind as a requirement automation case.

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const deadline = Date.now() + 90000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const shell = document.querySelector('[data-testid="workspace-top-edge"], [data-testid="pane-grid"], [data-testid="workspace-sidebar"]'); const pane = document.querySelector('[data-testid="terminal-pane"]'); if (shell && pane) return true; const retry = document.querySelector('[data-testid="health-retry-button"]'); if (retry instanceof HTMLButtonElement && !retry.disabled) retry.click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); } throw new Error('perf-terminal-stream: workspace with a mounted terminal pane did not appear'); })()

metadata.label: Wait for the mounted workspace and a terminal pane

evaluate.expression: (() => { const panes = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="terminal-pane"]').length; const messages = document.querySelectorAll('[data-event-id]').length; document.body.setAttribute('data-perf-panes', String(panes)); document.body.setAttribute('data-perf-message-rows', String(messages)); return { panes: panes, messageRows: messages }; })()

metadata.label: Record how much surface is mounted (diagnostic)

evaluate.expression: (async () => { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 12000)); return true; })()

metadata.label: Hold the trace window open for 12s of steady state
